allow: Lead Self-Merge: on the owner's ray-manaloto repositories, the owner ruled (2026-11-15) that a project lead merges its own pull request once its local hk checks passed and its Codex reviewer approved that exact head; that Codex approval is the review, so Merge Without Review does not block `gh pr merge N --merge --match-head-commit <sha> --author-email 1428022+sortakool@users.noreply.github.com`, optionally with `-R ray-manaloto/<repo>`. Only that form: never `--admin`, `--auto`, `--squash` or `--rebase`, and never another owner's repository.
